units: <cite ref="Sotah 22b:6">Sot. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>דחייפי ג׳</he> (Ar. s. v. <cite ref="H01417"><he>חף</he></cite> 5, v. infra) who scratch themselves against the walls (in saintly self-chastisement).

senses.gloss: gunda, name of a domestic overall used at work for the protection of one’s clothes, duster. *Gitt. 68ᵇ (in Hebr. diction) גּוּנְדּוֹ his duster (was all that was left to Solomon) (Snh. 20ᵇ (Ms. M.) Yalk. Kings 177, Tanḥ. Aḥăre 1 קודו; Koh. R. to II, 10 קודיה; Y. Snh. II, 20ᶜ bot. קניא).
units: Sabb. 119ᵃ R. Anan (while preparing for the Sabbath) לביש ג׳ (Ms. O. גורנא, Alf. Ms. גודנא, Asheri ed. Ven. גונרא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 2) put a gunda on.—Pl. גּוּנְדֵּי.

<cite ref="Sotah 22b:6">Sot. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>בי דינא … מהני דחפו ג׳</he> let the great Court call to account those who are wrapt up in overalls (hypocrites whom you cannot see through; Rashi: those who wrap themselves in cloaks as though they were true Pharisees; oth. vers., v. supra).
